NODEJS_SERVER_VARS.description: Key/value in JSON format (as an escaped string)

LIBSCRIPT_LISTEN_SOCKET.description: Global unix socket to listen on

NODEJS_SERVER_LISTEN_PORT.description: Port for NODEJS to listen on

NODEJS_SERVER_LISTEN_ADDRESS.description: Address for NODEJS to listen on

NODEJS_SERVER_LISTEN_SOCKET.description: Unix socket for NODEJS to listen on

NODEJS_SERVER_INSTALL_METHOD.description: How to install NODEJS SERVER. 'libscript_native' uses isolated version dirs, 'system' uses OS package manager, 'mise', 'asdf', 'pkgx', or 'vfox' defers to third-party tools.

NODEJS_SERVER_DOWNLOAD_URL.description: Override URL for downloading nodejs-server binary or archive artifacts.

NODEJS_SERVER_RELEASES_URL.description: Override URL for querying nodejs-server available remote releases.

NODEJS_SERVER_VERSION.description: Specific version of nodejs-server to install (e.g., latest, lts, or exact version).
